## LOAD PACKAGES

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

library(readxl)
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(parallel)
library(broom)
library(broom.helpers)

```

## READ IN DATA

```{r, results='hide', message=FALSE}

## Load complete analytic dataset (HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_Includedsubset) from 01_DataManage_Exclusion.qmd file
complete_subset <- readRDS("NewData/HRS_DNAm_meta_Cell9_IncludedsubsetSept222026.RDS")
dim(complete_subset)

```

## LOAD IN FUNCTIONS

```{r}

source('ELE_DNAm_functions.R')

```

## DEFINE MODEL EXPOSURES, OUTCOMES, AND COVARIATES

```{r}

## Unadjusted
  ## Define variables
exposure_vars <- c("childrural_democoggen", "SCHLYRS_rev", "LIVEGPAR_R", "CHSMOKE_R")
outcome_vars <- c("GRIM_residuals", "MPOA_residuals", "LEVINE_residuals", "HORVATH_residuals", "HANNUM_residuals")
outcome_vars_gm <- c("globalmethylation", "Island_mean", "OpenSea_mean", "Shelf_mean", "Shore_mean")

## HEALTH 
  ## Define model covariates
covars_health <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate") 

## Adjusted
  ## Define individual exposures corresponding to the covariates below
exposure_vars1 <- c("childrural_democoggen")
exposure_vars2 <- c("SCHLYRS_rev")
exposure_vars3 <- c("LIVEGPAR_R")
exposure_vars4 <- c("CHSMOKE_R")

## SES & BEHAVIOR 
  ## Define model covariates for socioeconomic and behavior models
covars_ses <- c("age", "sex", "raceethnicity_collapsed", "BEALE_latest", "Parent_Educ", "ATOTB_latest", "HIBP_latest", "DIAB_latest", "VIGACT_collapsed", "smoke_latest", "GR", "NK", "B", "CD8", "CD4", "Sample_Plate")  

```

## UNADJUSTED LINEAR REGRESSION

### Age Acceleration

```{r}

## Create combinations of all possible outcome and exposure relationships
var_combinations <- func_var_combinations(exposure_vars, outcome_vars)

## Run the unadjusted models
unadjusted_m1 <- run_linear_models(var_combinations, complete_subset)

# Save as new dataframe
saveRDS(unadjusted_m1, file = "Model_Diagnostics/unadjusted_primaryexposuresSept222026.RDS")

## Summarize models
unadjusted_m1_summaries_df <- models_summarize(var_combinations, unadjusted_m1)

## Export the combined data frame to a CSV file
writexl::write_xlsx(unadjusted_m1_summaries_df, "Output/Revisions/Unadjusted_MODEL3AA_SummarySept222026.xlsx")

#Separate model summaries and vif for export
unadj_AA <- unadjusted_m1_summaries_df$model_summaries
unadj_AA_vif <- unadjusted_m1_summaries_df$vif
```

## CO-EXPOSURE LINEAR REGRESSION

### Age Acceleration

```{r}
## CO-EXPOSURE EXPOSURE MODEL
grim_mutadj <- glm(GRIM_residuals ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed +GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

levine_mutadj <- glm(LEVINE_residuals ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

mpoa_mutadj <- glm(MPOA_residuals ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

horvath_mutadj <- glm(HORVATH_residuals ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

hannum_mutadj <- glm(HANNUM_residuals ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

#Get R2
with(summary(grim_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(levine_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(mpoa_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(horvath_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(hannum_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)

#Get VIF
car::vif(grim_mutadj)
car::vif(levine_mutadj)
car::vif(mpoa_mutadj)
car::vif(horvath_mutadj)
car::vif(hannum_mutadj)

## EXPORT
summary_grim_mutadj <- broom::tidy(grim_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "GRIM_residuals")
summary_levine_mutadj <- broom::tidy(levine_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "LEVINE_residuals")
summary_mpoa_mutadj <- broom::tidy(mpoa_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "MPOA_residuals")
summary_horvath_mutadj <- broom::tidy(horvath_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "HORVATH_residuals")
summary_hannum_mutadj <- broom::tidy(hannum_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "HANNUM_residuals")

mutadj_AA <- bind_rows(summary_grim_mutadj, summary_levine_mutadj, summary_mpoa_mutadj, summary_horvath_mutadj, summary_hannum_mutadj)  

mutadj_AA$FDR_p.value <- p.adjust(mutadj_AA$p.value, method = "fdr") 

writexl::write_xlsx(mutadj_AA, "Output/Revisions/ALLexposures_AA_SummarySept232026.xlsx")
```

### Array-wide (Global) Methylation

```{r}
global_mutadj <- glm(globalmethylation ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

island_mutadj <- glm(Island_mean ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

opensea_mutadj <- glm(OpenSea_mean ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

shelf_mutadj <- glm(Shelf_mean ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

shore_mutadj <- glm(Shore_mean ~ childrural_democoggen + SCHLYRS_rev + LIVEGPAR_R + CHSMOKE_R + age + sex + raceethnicity_collapsed + GR + NK + B + CD8 + CD4 + Sample_Plate, data = complete_subset, family = gaussian(link = "identity")) 

#Get R2
with(summary(global_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(island_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(opensea_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(shelf_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)
with(summary(shore_mutadj), 1-deviance/null.deviance)

#Get VIF
car::vif(global_mutadj)
car::vif(island_mutadj)
car::vif(opensea_mutadj)
car::vif(shelf_mutadj)
car::vif(shore_mutadj)

## EXPORT
summary_global_mutadj <- broom::tidy(global_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "globalmethylation")
summary_island_mutadj <- broom::tidy(island_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "Island_mean")
summary_opensea_mutadj <- broom::tidy(opensea_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "OpenSea_mean")
summary_shelf_mutadj <- broom::tidy(shelf_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "Shelf_mean")
summary_shore_mutadj <- broom::tidy(shore_mutadj, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(outcome = "Shore_mean")

mutadj_GM <- bind_rows(summary_global_mutadj, summary_island_mutadj, summary_opensea_mutadj, summary_shelf_mutadj, summary_shore_mutadj)   

mutadj_GM$FDR_p.value <- p.adjust(mutadj_GM$p.value, method = "fdr") 

writexl::write_xlsx(mutadj_GM, "Output/Revisions/ALLexposures_GM_SummarySept232026.xlsx")

```
